# `v3world/` — CR_MSG payloads of the eegfaktura-v3 world (scenario S13)

`crmsg.jsonl.gz`: 418 messages, one per line `{"topic": …, "message": {…}}` — the topic the energystore
subscribes to (`eda/response/<tenant>/protocol/cr_msg`) and the payload **decoded** the way the energystore
decodes it (base64 → gzip → JSON, `mqttclient/energyExecutor.go` `decodeMessage`). Fictional data.

| Community (tenant) | Days | Content |
|---|---|---|
| RC100401 (eegfaktura-v3 demo world, 14 members, 18 meters) | 2026-09-01 … 14, 2026-03-28 … 30 | households, heat pumps, a business, PV producers; a meter outage 12–14 Sept, L2/L3 estimates, gaps; the spring DST day (92 quarter hours) |
| RC100507 (variety community, 8 members, 11 meters) | 2026-09-01 … 14 | an L3 estimated stretch 1–7 Sept, gaps |

Methods L1 107 401, L2 2 541, L3 2 304 values; 16 series with gaps; consumer codes G.01/G.02/G.03,
producer codes G.01/P.01.

## Provenance

Generated by eegfaktura-v3's `energy-mock` (AGPL-3.0, same organisation) at commit `0b785d2` from its world
manifest (`tools/demo/make-legacy-world.py`, seed 7, plus the dev workspace's variety communities),
published with `energy-mock backfill --channel mqtt` to a local Mosquitto and recorded with `mosquitto_sub`
on 2026-10-08 (the dev workspace's `scripts/dev/world/record-energystore-fixtures.sh`). sha256 `ce7fd35105b7a71d…`.

**Refresh** (by hand, never in the build): seed the dev stack's test world, run the record script, run
`go test ./scenario/ -run TestS13`, update the commit id and checksum here and in `EXTERNAL_SOURCES.md`.
The test's oracle is the sum of these recorded values, never the store's own output.
